title: Oil Derrick Rig in Field with Spanish Moss, 1950s B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A square snapshot with deckled edges capturing an active oil derrick standing tall in a rural clearing, framed in the foreground by a barbed-wire fence and an oak tree draped with Spanish moss. The base of the lattice steel derrick features support sheds, pipes, and utility vehicles, reflecting the mid-20th-century postwar petroleum boom across the American South and Gulf Coast region.
